settings.title: Portfolio
settings.lead: Show work you’ve already done. Brands see approved items on your profile, and you can attach up to {max} when you apply.
settings.emptyLead: Add a screenshot of a story, a photo from a shoot or a Reel cover.
settings.limit: You’ve added the maximum of {max} items. Delete one to add another.
settings.reviewNote: We check each item before brands see it. Editing an approved item sends it back to review.
settings.deleteBody: It disappears from your profile and from applications it was attached to.

form.imageHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB. A story screenshot works too.
form.name: Title
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What you did and how it went
form.linkHint: Where to see it: a Reel, TikTok, YouTube video or a site.

faq.title: About your work
faq.lead: Optional. Brands see only the questions you answer.

questions.brandsWorked: What brands have you worked with?
questions.brandsWanted: What brands do you want to work with?

placeholders.brandsWorked: For example: two cafes in Yerevan, a gym, a clothing store
placeholders.audience: For example: women 20–30 in Yerevan who love food and travel
placeholders.brandsWanted: For example: restaurants, beauty salons, travel agencies

apply.title: Attach your work
apply.hint: Pick up to {max} to show the brand. Optional.
apply.none: Add work to your portfolio in Settings to show brands what you’ve done.
apply.pendingNote: Items in review show up here once approved.

admin.title: Portfolio review
admin.lead: Check each item before brands see it: the image suits brands and nothing is misleading.
admin.reasonHint: The blogger sees this and can fix the item.
